subject.title: [Bug]: When openclaw sends a link with an underscore to Feishu, the full hyperlink cannot be displayed

question: Should maintainers refresh/adopt one of the conflicting fork candidates, or sponsor a fresh same-repository Feishu URL-boundary fix for this issue?
rationale: The bug remains valid and narrow, but current no-new-fix-pr state plus conflicting fork candidates make the next step an ownership choice rather than another automatic duplicate fix branch.

options.title: Sponsor a fresh same-repository fix
options.body: Close or leave the fork PRs as source context, then queue a narrow Feishu plugin fix with focused tests and live Feishu proof.

options.title: Refresh one fork candidate
options.body: Pick the better fork candidate, resolve conflicts, and require regression coverage plus live behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Wait for contributor follow-up
options.body: Keep this issue open without new automation until a contributor updates a candidate branch with mergeable code and proof.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a fresh same-repository fix
recommendation.body: Close or leave the fork PRs as source context, then queue a narrow Feishu plugin fix with focused tests and live Feishu proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The Feishu README names this handle as the community-maintained plugin contact, so they are the best available owner for choosing the Feishu-specific repair path.
